from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    ranked = counts.most_common()
    fill = ranked[0][0]
    base = ranked[1][0]

    row_counts = [sum(v == base for v in row) for row in grid]
    col_counts = [sum(grid[r][c] == base for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
    mr, mc = max(row_counts), max(col_counts)
    rows = [r for r, n in enumerate(row_counts) if n >= mr * 0.5]
    cols = [c for c, n in enumerate(col_counts) if n >= mc * 0.5]

    # Keep the span of grid lines containing marked intersections.
    active_rows = [i for i, r in enumerate(rows)
                   if any(grid[r][c] != base for c in cols)]
    active_cols = [j for j, c in enumerate(cols)
                   if any(grid[r][c] != base for r in rows)]
    if not active_rows or not active_cols:
        return [[fill]]

    rows = rows[min(active_rows):max(active_rows) + 1]
    cols = cols[min(active_cols):max(active_cols) + 1]

    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)]
           for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                       grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]])
            if corners[0] != base and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                out[i][j] = corners[0]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def predominant(line):
        color, count = Counter(line).most_common(1)[0]
        return color, count / len(line)

    # Grid lines are the regularly spaced rows and columns whose dominant
    # color is the lattice color.
    row_candidates = [r for r in range(h)
                      if predominant(grid[r])[1] >= 0.75]
    col_candidates = [c for c in range(w)
                      if predominant([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)])[1] >= 0.75]

    def regular_subset(candidates):
        if len(candidates) < 2:
            return candidates
        gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(candidates, candidates[1:])]
        step = Counter(gaps).most_common(1)[0][0]
        # Keep coordinates on the dominant lattice spacing.
        return [x for x in candidates
                if sum(1 for y in candidates if 0 < abs(y - x) <= step) > 0]

    rows = regular_subset(row_candidates)
    cols = regular_subset(col_candidates)
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return grid

    marked = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(rows) for j, c in enumerate(cols)

    if not marked:

            out_row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != line_color and

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def dominant(line):
        color, count = Counter(line).most_common(1)[0]
        return color, count / len(line)

    row_info = [dominant(grid[r]) for r in range(h)]
    col_info = [dominant([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]

    # Lattice lines are the less frequent dominant color among strongly
    # uniform rows/columns; the other color is the repeating cell background.
    row_candidates = [x[0] for x in row_info if x[1] >= 0.70]
    col_candidates = [x[0] for x in col_info if x[1] >= 0.70]
    line_color = Counter(row_candidates + col_candidates).most_common()[-1][0]

    rows = [r for r, (color, frac) in enumerate(row_info)
            if color == line_color and frac >= 0.70]
    cols = [c for c, (color, frac) in enumerate(col_info)
            if color == line_color and frac >= 0.70]

    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return grid

    marked = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(rows) for j, c in enumerate(cols)
              if grid[r][c] != line_color]
    if not marked:
        return [[line_color]]

    r0, r1 = min(i for i, _ in marked), max(i for i, _ in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(j for _, j in marked), max(j for _, j in marked)
    rows = rows[r0:r1 + 1]
    cols = cols[c0:c1 + 1]

    other = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color]
    fill = Counter(other).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            top = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]])
            bottom = (grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]])
            if top[0] == top[1] == bottom[0] == bottom[1] and top[0] != line_color:
                out_row.append(top[0])
            else:
                out_row.append(fill)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
